  "stats": "Base: 32mm\n\nSpecial Rule: The Keep is an elusive Demiurg repair ship. When The Keep goes into base-to-base contact with another Demiurg vessel it will start to repair the other vessel. When in base-to-base contact, neither ship may fire any of their weapons, except for already loaded ordnance. In the end phase The Keep will repair D3 hits on the friendly vessel. (The repaired ship cannot gain more hull points than it originally started with). During the next full turn, neither ship can issue special orders aside from Brace for Impact. The Keep cannot repair itself. Notes: The Keep is heavily automated and counts its Leadership value as 9 at the start of the battle. The Keep’s Ld will drop by -1 for each point of damage it suffers but cannot drop below Ld5.\n\nBridge smashed critical hits will not inflict additional Leadership loss on a Demiurg ship, but instead cause an extra point of damage (and pos- sible attendant Ld loss) to the vessel.\n \nThe Keep is worth 100 Victory points but in a pure Demiurg fleet, or one that is fighting against Orks, it is worth 125 Victory points instead to reflect its extra determination or hatred for the warlike race. This does not affect its starting points cost. The Keep cannot use the Come to New Heading special order.",
